purpose: Test whether mel frames near the waveform word slot suffice for the complete color answer despite clip-wide preprocessing differences
system_prompt: Answer the spoken question with one color word.
frame_selection: valid log-mel frame centers from floor(slot_start_seconds*100)-5 through ceil(slot_end_seconds*100)+5 inclusive, clipped to valid frames; 100 frames per second from 160-sample hop at 16 kHz

conditions.word_only: base input_features with donor values only in selected word-adjacent mel frames
conditions.outside_only: donor input_features with base values restored in selected word-adjacent mel frames

primary_endpoint: complete one-word answer and normal EOS
limitation: Feature-space splicing creates a hybrid log-mel tensor, not a physically replayable waveform; it is a causal model-input control.
